Browse practical writing on marketing measurement, Bayesian modelling, incrementality and forecasting. Case studies will be added here as suitable work becomes available to publish.

```{=html}
<div class="content-filter">
  <label for="content-type-filter">Show</label>
  <select id="content-type-filter">
    <option value="all" selected>All content</option>
    <option value="Blog">Blogs</option>
    <option value="Case Study">Case studies</option>
  </select>
</div>
```

::: {#insights-listing}
:::

```{=html}
<p id="content-filter-empty" class="content-filter-empty" hidden>No items match this selection.</p>
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const filter = document.getElementById("content-type-filter");
  const items = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("[data-content-type]"));
  const emptyState = document.getElementById("content-filter-empty");

  if (!filter || items.length === 0) return;

  filter.addEventListener("change", () => {
    let visibleItems = 0;

    items.forEach((item) => {
      const isVisible = filter.value === "all" || item.dataset.contentType === filter.value;
      item.hidden = !isVisible;
      if (isVisible) visibleItems += 1;
    });

    emptyState.textContent = filter.value === "Case Study"
      ? "No case studies have been published yet."
      : "No items match this selection.";
    emptyState.hidden = visibleItems !== 0;
  });
});
</script>
```
